However, there are many people in charge who are asked by management, ``What will be better if we add it, and how much will it improve?'' and are unable to explain the effects with evidence and end their approval process. In a 2026 survey by PwC, only 9% of Japanese companies found that generative AI produced results that "significantly exceeded expectations." If introduced without deciding on the type of effect and how to measure it, AI agents will likely have the same results.
